# ML-KEM-1024 known-answer vector captured from the implementation QGuard
# Messaging SHIPPED before the FIPS 203 migration (pqcrypto-kyber 0.8.1, which
# vendors PQClean's ML-KEM initial-public-draft sources under the historical
# KYBER1024 symbol names).
#
# Its purpose is to prove that key material and containers already on users'
# disks keep working after the switch to pqcrypto-mlkem: decapsulating CT with
# SK under the new implementation must still yield exactly SS. The two differ
# only in how a keypair is expanded from its seed, never in encapsulation,
# decapsulation, or any encoding -- and this vector is what holds that true.
#
# Fields are hex. SK 3168 bytes, PK 1568, CT 1568, SS 32.



ss=c001044c1ef85ae391aeb43ad658aa03645b3b0d970f6093745ce11e73159ad1
